label: Late-episode D1 after an unrewarded a1 trip to rare S2, ramping up after trial 85
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 85, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 85, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.maximum(ep_trial - 85, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward==0) * np.maximum(ep_trial-85,0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 85, 0) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.4% of steps), only at D1. Its magnitude is set by the previous trial having been a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded, scaled by a linear ramp in episode trial beyond ~85 (activation grows to ~2 by trial 99). Other previous-trial patterns, GO and D2 give ~0. One observed-only term captures nearly all of it (dev 0.70 vs free fit 0.72). The free fit adds a slight belief_lo modulation (higher when S1 believed good) and window-start D1s whose previous trial is out of window; remaining misses are such window-start steps. No future variables used.

issues: The explanation's claim of a 'slight belief_lo modulation' is negligible. Adding last_is('a1 S2 u')*ramp*belief_lo to the short form moves test R^2 only from 0.7214 to 0.7214.

Most of the gap to the free fit (0.72 vs 0.75) comes from window-start D1s, where the previous trial is outside the window: misses shows actual values of 1.4-1.9 predicted at 0.098. That is a data artifact, not a gap in the label. A (prev_action == -1)*ramp term adds only +0.0001 on test because those window-start steps can't be told apart.

The short form under-predicts the early part of the ramp a little (e.g. trial 94: actual 1.96, predicted 1.18), but saturating versions score worse (clip variants 0.68-0.70 vs 0.72 for the linear ramp), so the linear ramp is a fair shape.

Specificity checks out: prev_reward==0 alone gives 0.11, prev_state==S2 alone gives 0.05, and a2 S2 u gives 0.0007. Firing really is specific to a1 -> S2 unrewarded, only at D1 (GO and D2 residuals are exactly 0).
